name: element.set_text
description: Write text to the element via ValuePattern.SetValue. Surfaces `readonly` (element is read-only) distinctly from `not_supported_by_target` (element doesn't expose ValuePattern at all).

text.description: UTF-8 text to write. Replaces the element's current value entirely.

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: uia_value_set
x-implementations.description: UIA `IUIAutomationValuePattern::SetValue`. The pattern's `IsReadOnly` property is checked first; readonly elements return ERR readonly without attempting the write.

x-implementations.name: msaa_iaccessible
x-implementations.description: MSAA `put_accValue`; for an edit window whose proxy lacks it, `WM_SETTEXT` via `SendMessageTimeout`.

windows-modern.description: ValuePattern.SetValue. Distinguishes ERR readonly (ValuePattern present, IsReadOnly=true — e.g. labels, disabled inputs) from ERR not_supported_by_target (ValuePattern absent — e.g. checkboxes, buttons). Use this verb instead of synthesising input.keyboard.type when the target supports ValuePattern: it bypasses focus and input-event delivery, working on background windows that can't receive synthetic input.

windows-classic.description: `put_accValue`, falling back to `WM_SETTEXT` on edit windows. `STATE_SYSTEM_READONLY` gives `ERR readonly`. On the line-framed wire `text` cannot contain CR, LF or `"` (§1.2.5). Shared MSAA rules (roles, tree shape, hidden elements, hung windows, handle limits): PROTOCOL.md §10.7.
